title: Raj Sisodia: Incorruptible 'belongs on the bookshelf of every leader in the world'
summary: Sisodia co-founded the Conscious Capitalism movement and holds the FEMSA chair in Conscious Enterprise at Tecnológico de Monterrey. He posted this after appearing as a guest on The Eric Ries Show — his second endorsement, after an October post recommending the book to Conscious Capitalists.
blockquote: Eric is one of the most important thinkers, writers, advisors, and influencers active in the world of business and leadership today, and it was a pleasure to exchange ideas with him. His new book “Incorruptible” belongs on the bookshelf of every leader in the world.
